title: 67 Entity
description: 67 Entity is a horror mod for Minecraft that adds a mysterious creature inspired by the “67” meme. The entity will stalk the player, appear in unexpected places, and create a constant feeling of fear and tension throughout the world.
body:
![67 Entity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f039b1ea78972d0a9738840aa0ec47bb7950f319.png)
## Long Description
67 Entity is a Fabric 1.20.1 psychological horror mod built around one idea — you are not alone, and you never were.

This mod does not rely on constant action or traditional combat. Instead, it creates a slow, creeping sense of presence. Something exists in your world that does not belong there, yet it behaves as if it has always been part of it.

At first, it is almost easy to ignore.

A shape in the distance that disappears when you look directly at it.  
A strange feeling that something moved behind you.  
A moment where a door is open, even though you are sure you closed it.

Then the pattern begins to form.

The entity does not rush. It observes. It waits. It learns how you move, how you build, how you explore your world. And the more time you spend in its presence, the less predictable everything becomes.

Sometimes it leaves signs behind. Sometimes it speaks through chat messages that feel too intentional to be random. Sometimes it simply stands still, watching you without moving, as if there is no need to hide anymore.

Over time, distance stops meaning safety.

The encounters become closer, more direct, more personal. The world starts to feel unstable in small but noticeable ways, as if reality itself is adjusting around something you are not meant to understand.

Eventually, running stops being an option.

The entity begins to chase, not to immediately harm, but to pressure, to corner, to force awareness. Every encounter feels like it is building toward something final — something the player cannot fully prepare for.

And when that moment arrives, it is no longer about curiosity or paranoia.

It is about escape.

---

## Features
- 2D billboard-style entity that appears at unpredictable distances  
- Dynamic stalking behavior that evolves over time  
- Environmental interaction including doors and placed signs  
- Unsettling and context-aware chat messages  
- Progressive escalation from distant sightings to direct encounters  
- Chase sequences focused on tension rather than damage  
- Full-screen scripted jumpscare event  
- Custom ambient sound design for psychological pressure  
- Configurable intensity and behavior settings  
- Multiplayer-compatible server-side event system  

Test command: `/spawn67`

---

This mod is designed to make familiar worlds feel unfamiliar again, as if something has been watching long before you ever noticed it.

## Warning
This mod contains horror elements, jumpscares, and sudden audio/visual effects.

Play at your own risk.
